mapper.select: SELECT model_bundle, weight_percent FROM recommendation_model_traffic ORDER BY model_bundle
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_model_traffic (model_bundle, weight_percent, updated_by) VALUES (#{modelBundle}, #{weightPercent}, #{updatedBy})
INSERT INTO recommendation_model_daily_usage (usage_date, model_bundle, request_count) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, #{modelBundle}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_count = request_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT model_bundle, SUM(request_count) AS requests FROM recommendation_model_daily_usage WHERE usage_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL #{days} DAY GROUP BY model_bundle
